q.en: Whose proverbs are these in the book of Proverbs?
q.ta: நீதிமொழிகள் புத்தகத்தில் உள்ள இந்த நீதிமொழிகள் யாருடையவை?

q.en: Whose son was Solomon, who wrote the proverbs?
Over which nation was Solomon king?
What do the proverbs help us to know?
To whom do the proverbs give subtilty?
What do the proverbs give to the young man?
What will a wise man do when he hears?
What is the beginning of knowledge?
Who despise wisdom and instruction?
Whose instruction should a son hear?
Whose law should a son not forsake?
What shall the father's instruction be to the head?
What should you not do if sinners entice you?
What did the sinners say to lay wait for?
How did the sinners say they would swallow people up?
q.ml: പാപികൾ അവരെ എങ്ങനെ വിഴുങ്ങും എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു?

q.en: With what did the sinners say they would fill their houses?
q.ta: பாவிகள் தங்கள் வீடுகளை எதினால் நிரப்புவோம் என்றார்கள்?
q.ml: പാപികൾ തങ്ങളുടെ വീടുകളെ എന്തുകൊണ്ടു നിറെക്കാം എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു?

q.en: How many purses did the sinners say they would all have?
q.ml: എല്ലാവർക്കും എത്ര സഞ്ചി ഉണ്ടായിരിക്കും എന്നു അവർ പറഞ്ഞു?

q.en: What should you refrain from their path?
Where do the feet of the wicked run?
In whose sight is the net spread in vain?
q.ta: யாருடைய கண்களுக்கு முன்பாக வலையை விரிப்பது விருதா?

q.en: What does the way of the greedy take away?
Who crieth without and uttereth her voice in the streets?
q.ta: வெளியே நின்று கூப்பிட்டு வீதிகளில் சத்தமிடுவது எது?

q.en: Whom does wisdom ask, How long will you love simplicity?
q.ta: எதுவரைக்கும் பேதைமையை விரும்புவீர்கள் என்று ஞானம் யாரிடம் கேட்கிறது?
q.ml: എത്രത്തോളം ബുദ്ധിഹീനതയിൽ രസിക്കും എന്നു ജ്ഞാനം ആരോടു ചോദിക്കുന്നു?

q.en: What will wisdom pour out on those who turn at her reproof?
What will wisdom do at your calamity?
To what is destruction compared when it comes?
What will wisdom not do when they call upon her?
What did they not choose?
Of what shall the wicked eat?

a.en: The fruit of their own way

q.en: What shall slay the simple?
What shall destroy fools?
What happens to whoever hearkens to wisdom?
Whom does the father address as he asks him to receive his words?
q.ta: தகப்பன் தன் வார்த்தைகளை ஏற்றுக்கொள்ளும்படி யாரை அழைக்கிறார்?

q.en: To what should you incline your ear?
To what should you apply your heart?
How should you seek wisdom?
For what should you search as you search for wisdom?
What will you understand if you seek wisdom?
What knowledge will you find?
Who giveth wisdom?
Out of whose mouth cometh knowledge and understanding?
For whom does the LORD lay up sound wisdom?
What is the LORD to those who walk uprightly?
Whose way does the LORD preserve?
What shall be pleasant unto your soul when wisdom enters your heart?
q.ta: ஞானம் இருதயத்தில் பிரவேசிக்கும்போது ஆத்துமாவுக்கு இன்பமாயிருப்பது எது?
q.ml: ജ്ഞാനം ഹൃദയത്തിൽ പ്രവേശിക്കുമ്പോൾ മനസ്സിന്നു ഇമ്പമായിരിക്കുന്നതു എന്തു?

q.en: What shall preserve you?
What shall keep you?
From whose way will wisdom deliver you?
In what ways do the froward walk?
In what do the froward rejoice?
From whom else will wisdom deliver you?
q.ml: ജ്ഞാനം വേറെ ആരുടെ വശത്തുനിന്നു നിന്നെ വിടുവിക്കും?

q.en: Whom has the strange woman forsaken?
What has the strange woman forgotten?
Unto what does her house incline?
Which paths do those who go to her not take hold of?
q.ta: அவளிடம் போகிறவர்கள் எந்தப் பாதைகளில் வந்து சேருகிறதில்லை?
q.ml: അവളുടെ അടുക്കൽ ചെല്ലുന്നവർ ഏതു പാതകളെ പ്രാപിക്കുന്നില്ല?

q.en: In whose way should you walk?
Who shall dwell in the land?
Who shall be cut off from the earth?
Who shall be rooted out of the earth?
What should my son not forget?
What shall the commandments add to you?
What two things should never forsake you?
Upon what should you write mercy and truth?
What shall you find in the sight of God and man?
q.ta: தேவனுடைய பார்வையிலும் மனுஷருடைய பார்வையிலும் எதைப் பெறுவாய்?

q.en: In whom should you trust with all your heart?
Unto what should you not lean?
What will God do if you acknowledge him in all your ways?
q.ta: எல்லா வழிகளிலும் அவரை நினைத்தால் அவர் என்ன செய்வார்?
q.ml: എല്ലാ വഴികളിലും അവനെ നിനെച്ചാൽ അവൻ എന്തു ചെയ്യും?

q.en: Whom should you fear and from what depart?
What shall the fear of the LORD be to your navel?
With what should you honour the LORD?
What shall be filled with plenty if you honour the LORD?
What shall burst out with new wine?
What should you not despise?
Whom does the LORD correct?
Who is happy?
What is better than the merchandise of silver?
Wisdom is more precious than what?
What is in wisdom's right hand?
What is in wisdom's left hand?
What are all the paths of wisdom?
What is wisdom to those who lay hold upon her?
By what did the LORD found the earth?
By what did the LORD establish the heavens?
What do the clouds drop down?
What shall wisdom and discretion be to your soul?
What shall not stumble when you walk safely?
How shall your sleep be when you lie down?
Who shall be your confidence?
What should you not withhold from those to whom it is due?
What should you not say to your neighbour when you have it by you?
q.ta: உன்னிடத்தில் பொருள் இருக்கையில் அயலானிடம் என்ன சொல்லக்கூடாது?

q.en: Against whom should you not devise evil?
With whom should you not strive without cause?

a.en: A man who has done you no harm

q.en: Whom should you not envy?
Who is an abomination to the LORD?
Where is the curse of the LORD?

a.en: In the house of the wicked

q.en: Whose habitation does the LORD bless?
To whom does the LORD give grace?
What shall the wise inherit?
What shall be the promotion of fools?
Whom does the father tell to hear the instruction of a father?
What does the father give his children?
What was the speaker in his father's sight?

a.en: A tender and only beloved son

q.en: How many children was he to his mother?
What did his father tell him to keep and live?
q.ta: அவன் தகப்பன் அவனை எதைக் கைக்கொள்ளச் சொன்னார்?

q.en: What two things should you get?
What will wisdom do if you do not forsake her?
What is the principal thing?
With all your getting, what should you get?
What will wisdom do to you if you exalt her?
q.ta: நீ ஞானத்தை மேன்மைப்படுத்தினால் அது உன்னை என்ன செய்யும்?
q.ml: ജ്ഞാനത്തെ ഉയർത്തിയാൽ അതു നിന്നെ എന്തു ചെയ്യും?

q.en: What will wisdom give to your head?
What will wisdom deliver to you?
What shall be many if you receive my sayings?
When you walk, what shall not be straitened?
What is your life, if you keep instruction?
Into whose path should you not enter?
Unless what do the wicked not sleep?
What bread do the wicked eat?
What wine do the wicked drink?
To what is the path of the just compared?
Until when does the path of the just shine more and more?
To what is the way of the wicked compared?
What are the words of wisdom to those who find them?
What should you keep with all diligence?
Out of the heart are what issues?
What should you put away from you?
Where should your eyes look?
To which sides should you not turn?

a.en: The right hand nor the left

q.en: What should you remove from evil?
Whom does the father call to attend to his wisdom?
q.ta: தகப்பன் தன் ஞானத்தைக் கவனிக்கும்படி யாரை அழைக்கிறார்?

q.en: What shall your lips keep?
What drop as a honeycomb?

a.en: The lips of a strange woman

q.en: Her mouth is smoother than what?
How bitter is her end?
How sharp is her end?
Where do her feet go down?
What do her steps take hold on?
Whom does the father call to hear him now?
q.ml: ഇപ്പോൾ അപ്പൻ തന്റെ വാക്കു കേൾക്കാൻ ആരോടു പറയുന്നു?

q.en: How far should you remove your way from her?
To what should you not come nigh?
To whom should you not give your years?
In whose house should your labours not be?
What did the man say he hated?
What did the man say he did not obey?
From whose cistern should you drink water?
From what should you drink running waters?
For whom alone should your fountains be?
In the wife of what time of life should you rejoice?
To what animals is the wife compared?

a.en: The loving hind and pleasant roe

q.en: Before whose eyes are the ways of man?
q.ta: மனுஷனுடைய வழிகள் யாருடைய கண்களுக்கு முன்பாக இருக்கிறது?

q.en: What shall take the wicked himself?
With what shall he be holden?
Why shall the wicked die?
For whom does the proverb say a son may become surety?
q.ta: நீதிமொழிகளில் மகன் யாருக்காகப் பிணைப்பட்டால் என்று சொல்லப்படுகிறது?
q.ml: ഒരു മകൻ ആർക്കു വേണ്ടി ജാമ്യം നിന്നാൽ എന്നു പറയുന്നു?

q.en: With what are you snared if you pledge for a friend?
Into whose hand has the one who pledged fallen?
What should you not give to your eyes and eyelids?
From whose hand should a roe deliver itself?
q.ta: வெளிமான் யாருடைய கைக்குத் தப்புவது போல தப்பவேண்டும்?
q.ml: മാൻ ആരുടെ കയ്യിൽനിന്നു വിടുവിക്കപ്പെടുന്നപോലെ നീ വിടുവിക്കണം?

q.en: From whose hand does a bird escape in the proverb?
q.ta: குருவி யாருடைய கைக்குத் தப்புவதுபோல என்று சொல்லப்படுகிறது?
q.ml: പക്ഷി ആരുടെ കയ്യിൽനിന്നു വിടുവിക്കപ്പെടുന്നപോലെ എന്നു പറയുന്നു?

q.en: To which small creature does Proverbs tell the sluggard to go?
Whom does the proverb call to consider the ant's ways?
q.ml: ഉറുമ്പിന്റെ വഴികളെ നോക്കി പഠിക്കാൻ വിളിക്കപ്പെടുന്നവൻ ആര്?

q.en: How many guides, overseers or rulers does the ant have?
q.ta: எறும்புக்குத் தலைவனும் அதிகாரியும் எத்தனை பேர் உண்டு?
q.ml: ഉറുമ്പിന്നു നായകനും മേൽവിചാരകനും അധിപതിയും എത്ര പേരുണ്ട്?

q.en: In which season does the ant provide her food?
In which season does the ant gather her food?
What question does Proverbs ask the sluggard about his sleeping?
q.ta: சோம்பேறியே, நீ எவ்வளவுநேரம் என்ன செய்வாய் என்று கேட்கப்படுகிறது?
q.ml: മടിയനോട് എത്രനേരം എന്തു ചെയ്യും എന്നു ചോദിക്കുന്നു?

q.en: What does the sluggard say he wants a little more of?
q.ta: சோம்பேறி இன்னுங் கொஞ்சம் என்ன செய்யட்டும் என்கிறான்?
q.ml: മടിയൻ കുറേക്കൂടെ എന്തു വേണം എന്നു പറയുന്നു?

q.en: What will come upon the sluggard like one who travelleth?
His want will come like what kind of man?
How does a wicked man walk according to Proverbs 6:12?
With what does the wicked man wink?
What does the wicked man sow?
How will calamity come upon the wicked man?
How many things does the LORD hate?
How many things are an abomination to the LORD?
What kind of look does the LORD hate?
What kind of tongue does the LORD hate?
What kind of hands does the LORD hate?
What kind of heart does the LORD hate?

a.en: A heart that deviseth wicked imaginations

q.en: What kind of witness does the LORD hate?
Among whom does the hated man sow discord?
Whose commandment should a son keep?
Where should the commandments be bound continually?
What shall the commandment do when you sleep?
What is the commandment compared to?
From whom does the commandment keep you?
What should you not lust after in your heart?
To what is a man brought by means of a whorish woman?
What can a man not take in his bosom without his clothes burning?
Upon what can a man not walk without his feet being burned?
Who shall not be innocent according to the proverb?
How much must a thief restore if he is found?
Who lacks understanding according to Proverbs 6:32?
What does the adulterer destroy?
What shall the adulterer get along with dishonour?
What is the rage of a man according to the proverb?
What should my son keep and lay up with him?
What happens if you keep the commandments?
The law should be kept like what part of the eye?
q.ta: போதகத்தை உன் கண்ணின் எதைப்போல் காத்துக்கொள்ள வேண்டும்?

q.en: Upon what should you bind the commandments?
Upon what should you write them?
What should you call wisdom?
What should you call understanding?
From whom will wisdom keep you?
q.ml: ജ്ഞാനവും വിവേകവും നിന്നെ ആരുടെ കയ്യിൽനിന്നു കാക്കും?

q.en: From where did the writer look out?
What did the writer see among the youths?

a.en: A young man void of understanding

q.en: At what time of day did the young man pass the corner?
Who met the young man?

a.en: A woman with the attire of an harlot
a.ml: വേശ്യാവസ്ത്രം ധരിച്ചും ഹൃദയത്തിൽ ഉപായം പൂണ്ടും ഉള്ളോരു സ്ത്രീ

q.en: What do her feet not do?
Where does she lie in wait?
What did the woman do to the young man after catching him?
q.ta: அந்த ஸ்திரீ அவனைப் பிடித்து என்ன செய்தாள்?
q.ml: ആ സ്ത്രീ അവനെ പിടിച്ചു എന്തു ചെയ്തു?

q.en: What did the woman say she had with her?
q.ml: തന്റെ പക്കൽ എന്തുണ്ടായിരുന്നു എന്നു അവൾ പറഞ്ഞു?

q.en: What did she say she had paid that day?
From which land was the fine linen on her bed?
q.ta: அவள் படுக்கையின் மெல்லிய வஸ்திரங்கள் எந்த தேசத்தவை?

q.en: With what three things had she perfumed her bed?
Until when did she invite him to take their fill of love?
q.ml: അവൾ എതുവരെ പ്രേമത്തിൽ രമിക്കാം എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു?

q.en: Where did the woman say her husband was?
q.ta: அவள் புருஷன் எங்கே போனான் என்று சொன்னாள்?
q.ml: അവളുടെ പുരുഷൻ എവിടെ പോയി എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു?

q.en: What did her husband take with him?
With what did she cause him to yield?
He went after her like what animal going to the slaughter?
q.ta: அவன் எந்த மிருகம் அடிக்கப்படச் செல்வதுபோல் சென்றான்?
q.ml: അവൻ അറുക്കുന്നേടത്തേക്കു പോകുന്ന ഏതു മൃഗത്തെപ്പോലെ ചെന്നു?

q.en: What did not the bird know as it hasted to the snare?
q.ta: கண்ணியில் விழத் தீவிரிக்கும் குருவி எதை அறியாது?

a.en: That it was for its life

q.en: Whom does the writer call to hearken to him?
q.ta: எழுதியவர் யாரை எனக்குச் செவிகொடுங்கள் என்று அழைக்கிறார்?
q.ml: എഴുതിയവൻ ആരെ തന്റെ വാക്കു കേൾപ്പിൻ എന്നു വിളിക്കുന്നു?

q.en: How many has the strange woman cast down wounded?
Where is her house the way to?
Who cries out and puts forth her voice in Proverbs 8?
Where does wisdom stand?

a.en: In the top of high places

q.en: Where does wisdom cry out in the city?
To whom does wisdom call?
What are the simple told to understand?
Of what kind of things will wisdom speak?
What shall wisdom's mouth speak?
What is an abomination to wisdom's lips?
What should we receive instead of silver?
What should we receive rather than choice gold?
What is wisdom better than?
With what does wisdom dwell?
What is the fear of the LORD?
Which four things does wisdom hate besides evil?
Who reign by wisdom?
Who decree justice by wisdom?
Who else rule by wisdom?
q.ml: ജ്ഞാനം മുഖാന്തരം ആധിപത്യം നടത്തുന്ന മറ്റുള്ളവർ ആർ?

a.en: All the judges of the earth

q.en: Who shall find wisdom?
Which riches are with wisdom besides honour?
Wisdom's fruit is better than what?
Whom does wisdom lead in the way of righteousness?
Who possessed wisdom in the beginning of his way?
q.ta: ஞானத்தைத் தமது வழியின் ஆதியாகக் கொண்டிருந்தவர் யார்?
q.ml: തന്റെ വഴിയുടെ ആരംഭമായി ജ്ഞാനത്തെ ഉളവാക്കിയവൻ ആര്?

q.en: What were there not when wisdom was brought forth?
Before what was wisdom brought forth?
Where was wisdom when God prepared the heavens?

What is an honour for a man?
Why will the sluggard not plow?
When shall the sluggard beg?
What is counsel in the heart of man like?
Who will draw out the counsel of the heart?
Who walketh in his integrity?
Who are blessed after the just man?
Where does the king sit who scattereth away all evil with his eyes?
q.ta: கண்களினால் சகல பொல்லாப்பையும் சிதறப்பண்ணும் ராஜா எங்கே வீற்றிருக்கிறான்?
q.ml: കണ്ണുകൊണ്ടു സകലദോഷത്തെയും പേറ്റിക്കളയുന്ന രാജാവു എവിടെ ഇരിക്കുന്നു?

q.en: What is an abomination to the LORD besides divers weights?
Who made the hearing ear and the seeing eye?
q.ta: கேட்கிற காதையும் காண்கிற கண்ணையும் உண்டாக்கியவர் யார்?
q.ml: കേൾക്കുന്ന ചെവിയും കാണുന്ന കണ്ണും ഉണ്ടാക്കിയവൻ ആര്?

q.en: What should we not love, lest we come to poverty?
With what shall we be satisfied if we open our eyes?
What does the buyer say when buying?
What is a precious jewel?
With what shall the mouth be filled afterwards, after bread of deceit?
q.ta: வஞ்சனையினால் வந்த போஜனத்தின்பின் வாய் எதினால் நிரப்பப்படும்?
q.ml: വ്യാജത്താൽ നേടിയ ആഹാരത്തിന്റെ പിന്നെ വായിൽ എന്തു നിറയും?

q.en: By what is every purpose established?
What does a talebearer reveal?
What shall be put out in obscure darkness for him who curseth his father or mother?
q.ml: അപ്പനെയോ അമ്മയെയോ ദുഷിക്കുന്നവന്റെ എന്തു കൂരിരുട്ടിൽ കെട്ടുപോകും?

q.en: On whom should we wait instead of recompensing evil?
q.ta: தீமைக்குச் சரிக்கட்டுவேன் என்று சொல்லாமல் யாருக்குக் காத்திருக்க வேண்டும்?

q.en: What is not good, besides divers weights?
By whom are man's goings ordered?
What does a wise king bring over the wicked?
What is the spirit of man?
What preserve the king?
By what is the king's throne upholden?
What is the glory of young men?
What is the beauty of old men?
Whose heart is in the hand of the LORD like rivers of water?
q.ml: ആരുടെ ഹൃദയം യഹോവയുടെ കയ്യിൽ നീർത്തോടുകണക്കെ ഇരിക്കുന്നു?

q.en: In whose hand is the king's heart?
What is every way of a man in his own eyes?
q.ta: மனுஷனுடைய வழியெல்லாம் அவன் பார்வைக்கு எப்படித் தோன்றும்?
q.ml: മനുഷ്യന്റെ വഴി ഒക്കെയും അവന്നു എങ്ങനെ തോന്നുന്നു?

q.en: Who ponders the hearts?
What is more acceptable to the LORD than sacrifice?
What is sin, along with a high look and a proud heart?
q.ta: மேட்டிமையான பார்வையும் அகந்தையான மனமும் உள்ள துன்மார்க்கர் போடுவது எது பாவம்?
q.ml: ഗർവ്വമുള്ള കണ്ണും അഹങ്കാരഹൃദയവും കൂടാതെ പാപമായിരിക്കുന്നതു എന്ത്?

q.en: Where do the thoughts of the diligent tend?
Where do the thoughts of everyone who is hasty tend?
By what kind of tongue is the getting of treasures a vanity?
What shall destroy the wicked?
Why shall the robbery of the wicked destroy them?
What is the work of the pure?
Where is it better to dwell than with a brawling woman in a wide house?
q.ta: சண்டைக்காரியோடே பெரியவீட்டில் குடியிருப்பதைப்பார்க்கிலும் எங்கே தங்குவது நலம்?
q.ml: ശണ്ഠകൂടുന്ന സ്ത്രീയോടുകൂടെ പാർക്കുന്നതിനെക്കാൾ എവിടെ പാർക്കുന്നതു നല്ലതു?

a.en: In a corner of the housetop

q.en: What does the soul of the wicked desire?
Who is made wise when the scorner is punished?
What does the wise receive when he is instructed?
Who overthrows the wicked for their wickedness?
Whose house does the righteous man wisely consider?
What happens to him who stops his ears at the cry of the poor?
q.ta: ஏழையின் கூக்குரலுக்குத் தன் செவியை அடைத்துக்கொள்ளுகிறவனுக்கு என்ன நேரிடும்?
q.ml: എളിയവന്റെ നിലവിളിക്കു ചെവി പൊത്തിക്കളയുന്നവന്നു എന്തു സംഭവിക്കും?

a.en: He shall cry himself and not be heard

q.en: What pacifies anger?
What pacifies strong wrath?
What is joy to the just?
What shall come to the workers of iniquity?
Where shall the man who wanders out of the way of understanding remain?
q.ta: விவேகத்தின் வழியை விட்டுத் தப்பிநடக்கிறவன் எங்கே தாபரிப்பான்?

a.en: In the congregation of the dead

q.en: What will he who loves pleasure become?
What two things, if loved, will keep a man from being rich?
Who shall be a ransom for the righteous?
Where is it better to dwell than with a contentious and angry woman?
q.ta: சண்டைக்காரியும் கோபக்காரியுமான ஸ்திரீயுடன் குடியிருப்பதைப் பார்க்கிலும் எங்கே குடியிருப்பது நலம்?
q.ml: ശണ്ഠയും ദുശ്ശീലവുമുള്ള സ്ത്രീയോടുകൂടെ പാർക്കുന്നതിലും എവിടെ പാർക്കുന്നതു നല്ലതു?

q.en: In whose dwelling is treasure and oil?
Who spends up the treasure?
What three things does he who follows after righteousness and mercy find?
Who scales the city of the mighty?
What does he who keeps his mouth and tongue keep his soul from?
q.ta: தன் வாயையும் நாவையும் காக்கிறவன் தன் ஆத்துமாவை எதற்கு விலக்கிக் காக்கிறான்?
q.ml: വായും നാവും സൂക്ഷിക്കുന്നവൻ തന്റെ പ്രാണനെ എന്തിൽനിന്നു സൂക്ഷിക്കുന്നു?

q.en: What is the name of the proud and haughty man?
What kills the slothful?
Why does the desire of the slothful kill him?
Who gives and spares not?
What is the sacrifice of the wicked?
Who shall perish?
What does a wicked man harden?
Against whom is there no wisdom, understanding or counsel?
q.ta: யாருக்கு விரோதமாக ஞானமும் புத்தியும் ஆலோசனையும் இல்லை?

q.en: For what day is the horse prepared?
Of whom is safety?
What is rather to be chosen than great riches?
What is better than silver and gold?
Who meet together?
Who is the maker of them all?
Who foresees the evil and hides himself?
Who pass on and are punished?
What two things bring riches, honour and life?
q.ta: ஐசுவரியமும் மகிமையும் ஜீவனும் எதற்கு வரும் பலன்?

a.en: Humility and the fear of the LORD

q.en: What are in the way of the froward?
Whom should we train up in the way he should go?
When will a trained child not depart from the way?
Who rules over the poor?
Who is servant to the lender?
What does he who sows iniquity reap?
What shall fail?
Who shall be blessed?

a.en: He that has a bountiful eye

q.en: What does the bountiful man give to the poor?
Whom should we cast out so that contention goes out?
Who shall be the friend of him who loves pureness of heart?
What do the eyes of the LORD preserve?
Whose words does the LORD overthrow?
Who says there is a lion outside?
q.ml: വെളിയിൽ സിംഹം ഉണ്ടു എന്നു പറയുന്നവൻ ആര്?

q.en: What does the slothful man say is outside?
q.ta: சோம்பேறி வெளியே இருக்கிறது என்று சொல்வது என்ன?
q.ml: മടിയൻ വെളിയിൽ ഉണ്ടു എന്നു പറയുന്നതു എന്ത്?

q.en: What is the mouth of strange women?
What is bound in the heart of a child?
What shall drive foolishness far from a child?
What shall come to him who oppresses the poor to increase his riches?
q.ta: தனக்கு அதிகம் உண்டாகத் தரித்திரனை ஒடுக்குகிறவனுக்கு என்ன வரும்?

q.en: What should we bow down to hear the words of the wise?
In whom should our trust be?
Why should we not rob the poor?
Where should we not oppress the afflicted?
Who will plead the cause of the poor?
With whom should we make no friendship?
What will we get to our soul if we learn the ways of an angry man?
q.ta: கோபக்காரனுடைய வழிகளைக் கற்றுக்கொண்டால் ஆத்துமாவுக்கு எதை வருவிப்போம்?
q.ml: കോപശീലന്റെ വഴികളെ പഠിച്ചാൽ പ്രാണൻ എന്തിൽ അകപ്പെടും?

q.en: For what should we not be sureties?
What will be taken from under you if you have nothing to pay?
q.ml: വീട്ടുവാൻ വകയില്ലാതെ വന്നാൽ നിന്റെ കീഴിൽനിന്നു എന്ത് എടുത്തുകളയും?

q.en: What should we not remove, which our fathers have set?
Before whom shall a man diligent in his business stand?
q.ta: தன் வேலையில் ஜாக்கிரதையாயிருக்கிறவன் யாருக்கு முன்பாக நிற்பான்?
q.ml: പ്രവൃത്തിയിൽ സാമർത്ഥ്യമുള്ള പുരുഷൻ ആരുടെ മുമ്പിൽ നില്ക്കും?

q.en: Before whom shall the diligent man not stand?
With whom are we told to sit and eat, considering diligently what is before us?
q.ta: யாரோடே போஜனம்பண்ண உட்கார்ந்தால் முன்பாக இருக்கிறதை நன்றாய்க் கவனிக்கவேண்டும்?
q.ml: ആരോടുകൂടെ ഭക്ഷണത്തിന്നു ഇരിക്കുമ്പോൾ നിന്റെ മുമ്പിൽ ഇരിക്കുന്നവൻ ആരെന്നു കരുതണം?

q.en: What should a man given to appetite put to his throat?
What kind of meat are the ruler's dainties?
What are we told not to labour to be?
What do riches make for themselves?
Like which bird do riches fly away toward heaven?
Whose bread should we not eat?
What does the man with an evil eye say to you, though his heart is not with you?
q.ta: வன்கண்ணன் உன்னோடே என்ன சொன்னாலும் அவன் இருதயம் உன்னோடே இராது?
q.ml: കണ്ണുകടിയുള്ളവൻ നിന്നോടു എന്തു പറയും, അവന്റെ ഹൃദയമോ അനുകൂലമല്ല?

q.en: What shall you do with the morsel you have eaten?
In whose ears should we not speak?
Why should we not speak in the ears of a fool?

a.en: He will despise the wisdom of your words

q.en: What should we not remove?
Whose fields should we not enter?
Who is mighty and will plead the cause of the fatherless?
To what should we apply our heart?
What should we not withhold from the child?
If you beat a child with the rod, what shall not happen to him?
q.ta: பிள்ளையைப் பிரம்பினால் அடித்தால் அவனுக்கு என்ன ஆகாது?

q.en: From what shall beating with the rod deliver the child's soul?
q.ta: பிரம்பினால் அடிப்பதால் அவன் ஆத்துமா எதிலிருந்து தப்பும்?
q.ml: വടികൊണ്ടു അടിക്കുന്നതിനാൽ അവന്റെ പ്രാണൻ എവിടെനിന്നു വിടുതൽ പ്രാപിക്കും?

q.en: What will rejoice if the son's heart is wise?
What shall rejoice when your lips speak right things?
q.ta: உன் உதடுகள் செம்மையானவைகளைப் பேசினால் எது மகிழும்?
q.ml: നിന്റെ അധരം നേർ സംസാരിച്ചാൽ എന്തു ആനന്ദിക്കും?

q.en: Whom should our heart not envy?
In what should we be all the day long?
What shall not be cut off?
Where should we guide our heart?
Among whom should we not be?

a.en: Winebibbers and riotous eaters of flesh

q.en: What shall come to the drunkard and the glutton?
With what shall drowsiness clothe a man?
Whom should we hearken to?
When should we not despise our mother?
What should we buy and not sell?
Who shall greatly rejoice?
Who shall be glad and rejoice?
What does the father ask his son to give him?
q.ta: தகப்பன் தன் மகனிடம் எதைத் தரும்படி கேட்கிறான்?

q.en: What is a whore?
What is a strange woman?
How does the strange woman lie in wait?
Who has woe, sorrow, contentions and wounds without cause?
q.ta: யாருக்கு வேதனை, துக்கம், சண்டைகள், காரணமில்லாத காயங்கள்?
q.ml: ആർക്കു കഷ്ടം, സങ്കടം, കലഹം, അനാവശ്യമായ മുറിവുകൾ?

a.en: They that tarry long at the wine

q.en: What should we not look upon when it is red?
Like what does wine bite at the last?
Like what does wine sting at the last?
What shall your eyes behold when you are drunk?
Like one lying in the midst of what shall you be?
What does the drunkard say he will seek yet again?
q.ta: குடிகாரன் பின்னும் தொடர்ந்து எதைத் தேடுவேன் என்பான்?
q.ml: ഞാൻ ഇനിയും ഏതു തേടും എന്നു കുടിയൻ പറയും?

q.en: Of whom should we not be envious?
What does the heart of evil men study?
By what is a house built?
By what is a house established?
By what are the chambers filled with all precious and pleasant riches?
Who is strong?
In what is there safety?
For whom is wisdom too high?
Where does a fool not open his mouth?
What shall he that devises to do evil be called?
What is the thought of foolishness?
Who is an abomination to men?
If you faint in the day of adversity, how is your strength?
Whom should we deliver?
Who ponders the heart and renders to every man according to his works?
q.ta: இருதயங்களைச் சோதித்து அவனவன் கிரியைக்குத்தக்கதாகப் பலனளிக்கிறவர் யார்?
q.ml: ഹൃദയങ്ങളെ തൂക്കിനോക്കി പ്രവൃത്തിക്കു തക്കവണ്ണം പകരം കൊടുക്കുന്നവൻ ആര്?

q.en: What does the father tell his son to eat, because it is good?
What shall come when you have found the knowledge of wisdom?
Against whose dwelling should the wicked not lay wait?
How many times does a just man fall and rise up again?
q.ta: நீதிமான் எத்தனை தரம் விழுந்தாலும் திரும்பவும் எழுந்திருப்பான்?

q.en: Into what shall the wicked fall?
When should we not rejoice?
What might the LORD turn away from our enemy if we rejoice at his fall?
q.ml: നാം സന്തോഷിച്ചാൽ യഹോവ ശത്രുവിങ്കൽനിന്നു എന്തു മാറ്റിക്കളയും?

q.en: Because of whom should we not fret?
What shall be put out for the wicked?
Whom should we fear?
How shall the calamity of the rebels rise?
What is not good in judgment?
What does the one who is cursed by the people say to the wicked?
q.ta: ஜனங்கள் சபிக்கும் மனுஷன் துன்மார்க்கனைப் பார்த்து என்ன சொல்லுகிறான்?

q.en: What shall come upon those who rebuke the wicked?
What kind of answer makes every man kiss the lips?
q.ta: எப்படிப்பட்ட மறுமொழி சொல்லுகிறவன் உதடுகளை முத்தமிடுகிறவனுக்குச் சமானம்?
q.ml: ഏതുതരം ഉത്തരം പറയുന്നവൻ അധരങ്ങളെ ചുംബനം ചെയ്യുന്നു?

q.en: What should we prepare first before building our house?
q.ml: വീടു പണിയുംമുമ്പു ആദ്യം എവിടെ വേല തീർക്കണം?

q.en: Against whom should we not be a witness without cause?
How should we not say we will do to the man who wronged us?
q.ta: நமக்குத் தீங்கு செய்தவனுக்கு எப்படிச் செய்வேன் என்று சொல்லக்கூடாது?
q.ml: നമ്മോടു ദോഷം ചെയ്തവനോടു എങ്ങനെ ചെയ്യുമെന്നു പറയരുതു?

a.en: As he has done to me

q.en: Whose field and vineyard did the writer go by?

a.en: The slothful and the man void of understanding

q.en: With what was the slothful man's field overgrown?
What covered the face of the field?
What was broken down in the field?
What do we say a little of, a little slumber, a little folding of the hands?
q.ml: കുറെക്കൂടെ എന്തു, കുറെക്കൂടെ നിദ്ര, കുറെക്കൂടെ കൈ കെട്ടി കിടക്ക?

q.en: Like whom shall your poverty come?
Like whom shall your want come?
What does not suit a fool, like snow in summer?
q.ta: கோடையில் உறைந்தபனி போல மூடனுக்குத் தகாதது என்ன?
q.ml: വേനൽകാലത്തു ഹിമം പോലെ ഭോഷന്നു പൊരുത്തമല്ലാത്തതു എന്ത്?

q.en: What is not seemly, like rain in harvest?
What shall not come when it is without cause?
What is for the horse?
What is for the ass?
What is for the fool's back?
Why should you not answer a fool according to his folly?
q.ml: മൂഢനോടു അവന്റെ ഭോഷത്വംപോലെ ഉത്തരം പറയരുതു എന്നതു എന്തുകൊണ്ട്?

q.en: Why should you answer a fool according to his folly?

a.en: Lest he be wise in his own conceit

q.en: What does he cut off who sends a message by a fool?
q.ta: மூடன் கையிலே செய்தி அனுப்புகிறவன் எதைத் தறித்துக்கொள்கிறான்?
q.ml: മൂഢന്റെ കൈവശം വർത്തമാനം അയക്കുന്നവൻ എന്തു മുറിച്ചുകളയുന്നു?

q.en: What is not equal, like a parable in the mouth of fools?
What is it like to give honour to a fool?

a.en: Binding a stone in a sling

q.en: What is a parable in the mouth of fools like?
q.ta: மூடன் வாயில் அகப்பட்ட பழமொழி எதைப் போன்றது?

a.en: A thorn in the hand of a drunkard

q.en: What does a dog return to?
Who returns to his folly like a dog to its vomit?
q.ta: நாய் கக்கினதைத் தின்னத் திரும்புவதுபோல் தன் மூடத்தனத்துக்குத் திரும்புகிறவன் யார்?
q.ml: നായി ഛർദ്ദിച്ചതിലേക്കു തിരിയുന്നതുപോലെ തന്റെ ഭോഷത്വം ആവർത്തിക്കുന്നവൻ ആര്?

q.en: Who has more hope than a man wise in his own conceit?
q.ta: தன் பார்வைக்கு ஞானியாயிருப்பவனைப் பார்க்கிலும் அதிக நம்பிக்கை யாரைக்குறித்து உண்டு?
q.ml: തനിക്കുതന്നേ ജ്ഞാനിയെന്നു തോന്നുന്നവനെക്കാൾ അധികം പ്രത്യാശ ആരെക്കുറിച്ചു ഉണ്ടു?

q.en: Who says there is a lion in the way?
q.ta: வழியிலே சிங்கம் இருக்கும் என்று சொல்பவன் யார்?
q.ml: വഴിയിൽ സിംഹം ഉണ്ടു എന്നു പറയുന്നവൻ ആര്?

q.en: Where does the slothful man say a lion is?
q.ta: சோம்பேறி சிங்கம் இருக்கிறது என்று எங்கே சொல்லுவான்?
q.ml: മടിയൻ സിംഹം ഉണ്ടു എന്നു എവിടെ പറയുന്നു?

a.en: In the way and in the streets

q.en: What turns upon its hinges like the slothful on his bed?
Where does the slothful hide his hand?
How many men who can render a reason is the sluggard wiser than in his own eyes?
q.ta: புத்தியுள்ள மறுஉத்தரவு சொல்லத்தகும் எத்தனை பேரைப்பார்க்கிலும் சோம்பேறி தன்னை ஞானியாக எண்ணுகிறான்?
q.ml: ബുദ്ധിയോടെ പ്രതിവാദിപ്പാൻ കഴിയുന്ന എത്ര പേരിലും മടിയൻ താൻ ജ്ഞാനി എന്നു കരുതുന്നു?

q.en: What is it like to meddle with strife that does not belong to you?

a.en: Taking a dog by the ears

q.en: What does a mad man cast about?
What does the man who deceives his neighbour say?
What goes out where there is no wood?
What ceases where there is no talebearer?
Who is to kindle strife as wood is to fire?
q.ta: விறகு நெருப்புக்கு ஏதுவானதுபோல சண்டைகளை மூட்ட ஏதுவானவன் யார்?
q.ml: വിറകു തീക്കു എന്നപോലെ കലഹം ജ്വലിക്കുന്നതിന്നു കാരണമായവൻ ആര്?

q.en: Whose words are as wounds going into the innermost parts?
What are burning lips and a wicked heart like?
q.ta: நேச அனலைக் காண்பிக்கிற உதடுகளோடு தீய நெஞ்சம் எதைப் போலிருக்கும்?

a.en: A potsherd covered with silver dross

q.en: How many abominations are in the heart of the one who speaks fair?
q.ml: ഇമ്പമായി സംസാരിക്കുന്നവന്റെ ഹൃദയത്തിൽ എത്ര വെറുപ്പു ഉണ്ടു?

q.en: Where shall the wickedness of the one who hides hatred by deceit be shown?
q.ta: பகையை வஞ்சகமாய் மறைக்கிறவனுடைய பொல்லாங்கு எங்கே வெளிப்படுத்தப்படும்?
q.ml: പകയെ കപടംകൊണ്ടു മറെച്ചുവെക്കുന്നവന്റെ ദുഷ്ടത എവിടെ വെളിപ്പെടും?

q.en: Who shall fall into the pit he digs?
What will return upon the one who rolls it?
What does a flattering mouth work?
What should you not boast of?
Who should praise you, and not your own mouth?
q.ta: உன் வாய் அல்ல, யார் உன்னைப் புகழட்டும்?

q.en: What is heavier than a stone and sand?
What is cruel?
What is better than secret love?
Whose wounds are faithful?
Whose kisses are deceitful?
To whom is every bitter thing sweet?
What does the full soul loathe?
What is a man who wanders from his place like?
q.ta: தன் ஸ்தானத்தைவிட்டு அலைகிற மனுஷன் எதைப் போலிருக்கிறான்?

a.en: A bird that wanders from her nest

q.en: What rejoice the heart?
Whose friend should you not forsake besides your own?
Who is better than a brother far off?
Why should a son be wise and make his father's heart glad?
q.ta: மகன் ஞானவானாகி இருதயத்தைச் சந்தோஷப்படுத்த வேண்டியது ஏன்?

q.en: What should you take from him that is surety for a stranger?
What shall be counted a curse to him that blesses his friend with a loud voice?
q.ta: உரத்தசத்தத்தோடே சிநேகிதனுக்குச் சொல்லும் ஆசீர்வாதம் எவ்வாறு எண்ணப்படும்?

q.en: What is like a continual dropping in a very rainy day?
q.ml: പെരുമഴയുള്ള ദിവസത്തിലെ ഇടവിടാത്ത ചോർച്ചയും ആർക്കു ഒരുപോലെ?

q.en: What does he hide who tries to hide a contentious woman?
q.ml: അവളെ ഒതുക്കുവാൻ നോക്കുന്നവൻ എന്തിനെ ഒതുക്കുവാൻ നോക്കുന്നു?

q.en: What sharpeneth iron?
Who shall eat the fruit of the fig tree?
Where does face answer to face?
What are never full?
What are never satisfied?
What is a man's test, like a furnace for gold?
q.ta: பொன்னுக்குப் புடம் போல மனுஷனுக்குச் சோதனை எது?
q.ml: പൊന്നിന്നു മൂശ പോലെ മനുഷ്യന്നു ശോധന എന്ത്?

q.en: Where might a fool be bruised with a pestle?
q.ta: மூடனை உலக்கையினால் எதில் போட்டுக் குத்தினாலும் மூடத்தனம் நீங்காது?
q.ml: ഭോഷനെ ഉലക്കകൊണ്ടു എവിടെ ഇട്ടു ഇടിച്ചാലും ഭോഷത്വം മാറുകയില്ല?

q.en: What should you be diligent to know?
What are not for ever?
What are the lambs for?
What are the goats the price of?
What milk is enough for your food?
Which king's words are recorded in Proverbs 31?
q.ta: நீதிமொழிகள் 31-ல் எழுதப்பட்ட வசனங்கள் எந்த ராஜாவுக்கு அடுத்தவை?

q.en: Who taught King Lemuel the prophecy?
What did Lemuel's mother call him, the son of her womb?
q.ta: லேமுவேலின் தாய் அவனை எந்த புத்திரன் என்று அழைத்தாள்?
q.ml: ലെമൂവേലിന്റെ അമ്മ അവനെ ഏതു മകൻ എന്നു വിളിച്ചു?

q.en: What did Lemuel's mother say not to give to women?
q.ta: லேமுவேலின் தாய் ஸ்திரீகளுக்கு எதைக் கொடாதே என்றாள்?
q.ml: ലെമൂവേലിന്റെ അമ്മ സ്ത്രീകൾക്കു എന്തു കൊടുക്കരുതു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു?

q.en: What did she say not to give to that which destroyeth kings?
q.ta: ராஜாக்களைக் கெடுக்கும் காரியங்களுக்கு எதைக் கொடாதே என்றாள்?
q.ml: രാജാക്കന്മാരെ നശിപ്പിക്കുന്നവർക്കു എന്തു കൊടുക്കരുതു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു?

q.en: What is not for kings to drink?
For whom is strong drink not fitting?
Why should kings not drink wine?
Whose judgment might drunken kings pervert?
To whom should strong drink be given?

a.en: Him that is ready to perish

q.en: To whom should wine be given?
What should the one who drinks forget?
For whom should we open our mouth?
How should we judge, according to Proverbs 31?
Whose cause should we plead?
What is the price of a virtuous woman far above?
Who safely trusts in the virtuous woman?
What does she do to her husband all the days of her life?
q.ta: அவள் தன் புருஷனுக்கு உயிரோடிருக்கும் நாளெல்லாம் என்ன செய்கிறாள்?

q.en: What does she seek?
How does she work with her hands?
What is the virtuous woman like?
From where does she bring her food?
When does she rise?
To whom does she give a portion?
What does she consider and buy?
What does she plant with the fruit of her hands?
q.ta: அவள் தன் கைகளின் சம்பாத்தியத்தினால் எதை நாட்டுகிறாள்?

q.en: With what does she gird her loins?
What does not go out by night?
What do her hands hold?
To whom does she stretch out her hand?
What is she not afraid of for her household?
With what are all her household clothed?
What is her clothing?
Where is her husband known?
With whom does her husband sit?
What does she make and sell?
To whom does she deliver girdles?
What are her clothing?
With what does she open her mouth?
What is in her tongue?
What bread does she not eat?
Who arise and call her blessed?
q.ml: എഴുന്നേറ്റു അവളെ ഭാഗ്യവതി എന്നു പുകഴ്ത്തുന്നതു ആര്?

q.en: What did her husband say she did to all the daughters?
q.ta: அவள் புருஷன் அவளை மற்ற பெண்களைவிட எப்படிப் புகழுகிறான்?
q.ml: ഭർത്താവു അവളെ മറ്റു തരുണികളെക്കാൾ എങ്ങനെ പ്രശംസിക്കുന്നു?

q.en: What is deceitful?
What is vain?
Which woman shall be praised?

a.en: A woman that feareth the LORD

q.en: Where should her own works praise her?
